name: Apify
summary: Run Apify Actors (ready-made scrapers for Google, LinkedIn, Meta ads, TikTok, Lazada, Weibo and more), poll their runs and read the datasets they produce.

api_token.description: Apify API token (Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations)

notes: Apify is a platform of Actors: the data source is the Actor you run (store.search finds them), and each Actor defines its own JSON input. This catalog covers the platform calls; Actor inputs go through the raw call.
Runs are asynchronous: actors.run, then poll actor_runs.get until finished, then read actor_runs.dataset_items (or use actors.run_sync_items for runs under 300 seconds).
Runs cost money (compute units plus any pay-per-result or pay-per-event fees); maxTotalChargeUsd caps a run.
Lists page by offset and limit; results come wrapped in data with total, count and items. Actor ids are id or username~actor-name.

endpoints.summary: Private account data: username, plan and profile.

endpoints.summary: Plan limits and current usage against them.

endpoints.summary: Usage and cost for a billing cycle.

endpoints.name: Search the Apify Store
endpoints.summary: Public Actors (scrapers and tools) by keyword, category or pricing model.

includeInputSchema.description: Add each Actor's compact input schema.

limit.description: Max items (default and max 1000 for lists).
Max items (default and max 1000 for lists).

endpoints.name: Get an Actor
endpoints.summary: Details of one Actor, including its default run options.

endpoints.name: Start an Actor run
endpoints.summary: Starts a run and returns at once; poll actor_runs.get, then read actor_runs.dataset_items.

memory.description: Memory in MB, a power of 2, min 128.

maxItems.description: Cap on charged dataset items for pay-per-result Actors.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Cap on the run's total cost in USD.

build.description: Build tag or number; default is the Actor's default build.

waitForFinish.description: Seconds the server may wait for the run to finish, up to 60.

notes: Starts a job that bills your Apify account (compute and pay-per-result fees): set maxTotalChargeUsd. A read here because scrapers only produce data, but an Actor can have side effects: run only Actors you know. The JSON body is the Actor's own input and varies per Actor: send it through the raw call (the endpoint declares no body fields).
Marked write: an Actor runs arbitrary code with your account and can post, send or change things on other sites, and it bills compute.

endpoints.name: Run an Actor and return its items
endpoints.summary: Runs an Actor and returns its dataset items in one call; must finish within 300 seconds.

memory.description: Memory in MB, a power of 2, min 128.

maxItems.description: Cap on charged dataset items for pay-per-result Actors.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Cap on the run's total cost in USD.

build.description: Build tag or number; default is the Actor's default build.

format.description: json (default), jsonl, csv, html, xlsx, xml or rss.

clean.description: Only non-empty items, no hidden fields.

limit.description: Max items; no limit by default.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a run that produces data and waits (up to 300 s) for it. It bills your Apify account: set maxTotalChargeUsd. The JSON body is the Actor's own input and varies per Actor: send it through the raw call (the endpoint declares no body fields).
Marked write: an Actor runs arbitrary code with your account and can post, send or change things on other sites, and it bills compute.

memory.description: Memory in MB, a power of 2, min 128.

maxItems.description: Cap on charged dataset items for pay-per-result Actors.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Cap on the run's total cost in USD.

build.description: Build tag or number; default is the Actor's default build.

waitForFinish.description: Seconds the server may wait, up to 60.

notes: Starts a job that bills your Apify account. A read because the task's preset input decides what it does: run only tasks you know. An optional JSON body overrides fields of the task input; send it through the raw call.
